children: QDM International, through its subsidiary YeeTah, engaged a software developer to build an insurance information and comparison application with artificial intelligence features for HK$23.5 million, approximately US$3 million. Payments are tied to project milestones and verified performance, with potential reductions for missed performance targets. The six-month agreement gives YeeTah a non-exclusive right to use the service in its brokerage business; the developer retains the software and AI intellectual property.
: Develop an AI-enabled insurance information and comparison application for YeeTah's brokerage business
